# Command-Line Reference

Every block on this page is text the program prints, taken from its source, so the page cannot describe a command or an option that `rasterfold` does not have. `rasterfold help` prints the summary and `rasterfold help <command>` prints one command.

<!-- version-labels:begin -->
| Kind | Current | What it governs |
| ---- | ------- | --------------- |
| Product | RasterFold 1.0.0, in development and not released; no release has been published yet | The command-line tool, the libraries and this documentation, released together. |
| File format | `.fold` format version 3 | What a `.fold` file contains. It changes only when the file layout does, independently of the product and of the C API. |
| C API | C API 1.0 | The functions and types in `rasterfold.h`. It changes only when the library interface does, independently of the product and of the file format. |
<!-- version-labels:end -->

## Summary

```text
RasterFold lossless image codec
usage:
  rasterfold encode [--time] [--threads N] [--overwrite] input.bmp|input.png|input.ppm output.fold
  rasterfold decode [--time] [--threads N] [--overwrite] input.fold output.bmp|output.png|output.ppm
  rasterfold inspect [--time] [--json] input.fold
  rasterfold verify [--threads N] input.fold
  rasterfold help [command]
  rasterfold version
commands:
  encode   encode a BMP, PNG, or PPM image into a .fold file
  decode   decode a .fold file into a BMP, PNG, or PPM image
  inspect  print what a .fold file holds, as text or JSON
  verify   decode a .fold file in memory and print its pixel hash; writes nothing
  help     print this summary, or one command's usage with `help <command>`
  version  print the format and API versions
--threads 1 codes on one thread; the default uses up to 9 when the CPU has them.
exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 io, 3 unsupported, 4 malformed, 5 limit
```

## `rasterfold encode`

```text
usage: rasterfold encode [--time] [--threads N] [--overwrite] input.bmp|input.png|input.ppm output.fold
Encode a 24-bit BMP, 8-bit PNG, or P6 PPM (maxval 255) image into a .fold file. An existing output file is refused unless --overwrite is given.
options: --time prints timing statistics; --threads N codes on N threads (1 to 9); --overwrite replaces an existing output file.
exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 io, 3 unsupported, 4 malformed, 5 limit
example: rasterfold encode photo.bmp photo.fold
```

## `rasterfold decode`

```text
usage: rasterfold decode [--time] [--threads N] [--overwrite] input.fold output.bmp|output.png|output.ppm
Decode a .fold file into a 24-bit BMP, 8-bit PNG, or P6 PPM (maxval 255) image. An existing output file is refused unless --overwrite is given.
options: --time prints timing statistics; --threads N codes on N threads (1 to 9); --overwrite replaces an existing output file.
exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 io, 3 unsupported, 4 malformed, 5 limit
example: rasterfold decode photo.fold photo.bmp
```

## `rasterfold inspect`

```text
usage: rasterfold inspect [--time] [--json] input.fold
Print what a .fold file holds, fully validating its payload. --json prints one JSON object and refuses --time.
options: --time prints timing statistics (text form only); --json selects the JSON form.
exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 io, 3 unsupported, 4 malformed, 5 limit
example: rasterfold inspect --json photo.fold
```

## `rasterfold verify`

```text
usage: rasterfold verify [--threads N] input.fold
Decode a .fold file in memory, checking every checksum and stream end, and print the CRC32 of the decoded pixels. Writes nothing.
options: --threads N decodes on N threads (1 to 9).
exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 io, 3 unsupported, 4 malformed, 5 limit
example: rasterfold verify photo.fold
```

## `rasterfold help`

```text
usage: rasterfold help [command]
Print the command summary, or one command's usage, options, exit codes, and example.
exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage
example: rasterfold help encode
```

## `rasterfold version`

```text
usage: rasterfold version
Print the .fold format versions this build reads and writes and the C API version. --version is the same command.
exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage
example: rasterfold version
```
